07 /THE PRINCIPLE

If a number can't be traced to the page it came from, it doesn't go in the packet.

08 /QUESTIONS
Who is Mozart for?

Any business short-paid against its invoices: food and consumer brands selling through retailers and distributors, staffing firms, and freight carriers.

Does Mozart file anything without us?

No. Every dispute is approved by a person on your team before Mozart files it.

What does Mozart need from us?

A forwarding rule for deduction emails, a QuickBooks connection and the portal sign-ins you want used.

How is Mozart priced?

On a contingency basis: a share of what is actually recovered and attributable to Mozart.
